Subject: Forecast lag resolution sprint — EMEA & APAC owners: please certify

Quick note — finance flagged a growing number of stalls for EMEA/APAC opportunities in the 60–45 day band (mostly late approvals + missing stage). We need a short, focused hygiene sprint to clear holds and certify commit status before Friday close.

Action items (please):
- Owners: run the attached hygiene checklist for your top 12 open deals (by ARR). Mark as Commit / At Risk / No Go in column D.
- If the reason is procurement or legal, CC the external contact and include expected date.
- Enter a one-line status in HubSpot (link below) and reply to this thread with any escalations.

Timeline: Start today (16 Nov), interim check-in Wed 11/17 09:00 UTC, final sign-off Thu 11/18 15:00 UTC.

Why this matters: finance needs a certified lock to finalize November revenue recognition planning; late movement causes forecast drift.

Attachment: 20261116-forecast-hygiene-checklist.xlsx

— Karthik

- Vanessa: confirm the ScribeTech tech call summary in HS after the 10:00 CET call.

Finance will treat deals marked Commit in HubSpot as the source of truth at 15:00 UTC tomorrow. If you cannot certify by then, mark the deal as At Risk and leave a one-line reason.

Two small process reminders:
- Always attach a procurement contact (email) to the deal record — helps automation.
- Use the checklist template to surface exact gating items (PO / SOW redline / legal approval / tax clearance).

Thanks — I know this is a sprint but it’ll save a lot of downstream reconciliations.
